main_measure.name: slope of drift-adjusted 24-bar forward return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: positive slope with t >= 2 confirms (with second-day check), negative with t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: second-day (t+24 to t+48) slope t below 2

decided_by: Main slope positive with t >= 2 over at least 200 cases with forecast > 0, and the second-day slope's t is below 2.
reading: Cases are the first regime 'mean_reversion' bar in each 24-row grid cell from each window's first row, all such cases (forecast 0 included) enter the regression, the drift is the coin's mean non-overlapping 24-bar return over all windows (used for both days), and the second-day regression uses those cases whose t+48 close lies in the same window.
